clips.title: The story
paras: This quest marks the search for the final component needed to restore Dartol's Rod, an ancient relic tied to cleansing Ashenvale. Shael'dryn directs travelers toward the fallen druid sanctuary of Dor'Danil to recover the missing iron pommel.

The final piece of Dartol's Rod—an iron pommel—was entrusted to the night elf druids dwelling at the Dor'Danil barrow den. Tragically, the sanctuary fell to disaster, and its caretakers were slain. With the druids dead and their refuge overrun, the exact hiding place of the relic was lost, leaving scavengers and wandering oozes to swallow up whatever was left behind in the ruins east of the southern road.

Dartol was a now-dead evil wizard, but the rod he created holds transformative powers. Raene Wolfrunner and Shael'dryn seek to reassemble the artifact in the hope that it can help slow the furbolg attacks on Ashenvale's night elves. Securing the iron pommel is the last step required before Shael'dryn can attempt to mend the fractured rod at the moonwell.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The final piece of the rod was given to the druids of Dor'Danil for safekeeping. I have no idea where they hid it. I'm sorry I can't help you more than that.

All I can tell you is to follow the road that leads towards the Barrens. The druids took shelter to the east of that road, but they won't be of much help to you: they were killed recently... It's something I don't like to think about much.
When you find the final piece, bring it to me and I will help you reconstruct the rod.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you find the final piece of the rod, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You found the final piece? Wonderful for you... And for Raene.
I guess we'll have to see about repairing it, won't we?
